status: policy_dev selection rule, declared BEFORE the 2019H2 finiteness scan, BEFORE the manifest is built and BEFORE any value of any 2019H2 timestep is read by FP-05b
written_from: calendar arithmetic on the pinned split freeze only (no store value read)

pool.definition: the 6h issue slots t whose support t-12h..t+72h lies inside 2019.zarr and does not touch any gradient/result exposure run of the FP-05a ledger widened by 24h (closed intervals; conservative rule incl. the S0 aggregate result from 2020-01-01T00Z), restricted to 2019 H2

strata.definition: 7-day UTC blocks starting at 2019-07-06T12Z: block(t) = floor((t - 2019-07-06T12Z) / 168h)
strata.note: the same blocks are the OOF-v1 blocks and the bootstrap unit

targets.formula: target_i = 746 + floor(i * 697 / 127 + 0.5), i = 0..127 (store step index; no exact .5 case exists since 127 is odd)

candidates: slots t in the pool whose store steps t-2 .. t+12 are ALL absent from splits/finiteness_scan_2019_H2.json steps_with_nonfinite (finiteness only)
pick: targets are processed in increasing i. For target_i: among UNUSED candidates in the SAME stratum as target_i and strictly later than the previous kept pick (time order is kept), take the one nearest to target_i; ties go to the earlier slot. If no such candidate exists, target_i is DROPPED.
stop_rule: more than 8 DROPPED targets -> STOP (no reselection without the coordinator). If any picked row is then rejected by the admission gate (B09 time join or B08 content certificate) -> STOP and report; no replacement, no reselection without the coordinator.
rows: the library's own build_manifest(years=[2019], lead_hours=[72], normalization_hash='3e0b216bfbf34ab0', formal=True) rows at exactly the picked issue times, in time order; nothing hand-constructed; each row must pass split_freeze.assert_rows_clear(role='policy_dev', pre_admission=True) before the manifest is written
admission_command: PYTHONPATH=.pydeps python3 scripts/r2_admission_gate.py --manifest <run>/admission/policy_dev_manifest.json --formal --data-role policy_dev --history-steps 2 --limit <N_target> --verify-content --content-samples <N_target> --normalization-dir reference/stormer/normalization_constants --json <run>/admission/policy_dev_admission.json (certificates span t-12h..t+72h = steps t-2..t+12)
disclosure: 147 pool-period issue times were integrity-read (content hashes/finiteness, no model, no gradient) by the stopped shared-F0 sprint; DISCLOSED_NOT_EXCLUDED; label RETROSPECTIVE_HELD_PERIOD_DEV_NOT_HISTORICAL_DEPLOYMENT
why_this_is_not_skill_selection: targets are a fixed calendar grid; the only data-dependent step is raw-data finiteness (integrity), and admission's integrity certificate; no model output, loss, gain or weather statistic exists for these rows or is consulted
use_restriction: no model output is computed on these rows before the pre-registered FP-05b job C-J2
